name: DE Rantau Nomad Pass

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 24,000/year in income from foreign-based clients or employers, for tech and digital-economy roles (software engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, AI/machine learning, digital marketing, digital content creation).
requirements.fix_path: Document at least USD 24,000/year in verifiable foreign-sourced income.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 60,000/year in income (or USD 5,000/month), for a broadened category of non-tech senior business and specialist roles (founders, CEOs, COOs, tax accountants, legal counsel, technical writers, business development managers, PR professionals) added to the programme on 7 June 2024.
requirements.fix_path: Document at least USD 60,000/year in verifiable foreign-sourced income.

evidence_required.document: Active contracts, purchase orders, or invoices from foreign clients/employers showing contract duration and value
Health insurance valid for the full stay, explicitly covering treatment in Malaysia
MDEC online application; RM 1,080 main-applicant fee (RM 540 per dependant) plus an RM 90-per-3-months (RM 360/year) immigration pass fee, processed in 6-8 weeks

outcome.duration_length: Professional Visit Pass valid 3-12 months per grant, renewable (apply 2 months before expiry) up to a maximum of 24 months total

sources.title: Ministry of Digital Malaysia (digital.gov.my) -- DE Rantau Nomad Pass eligibility expanded, 7 June 2024 announcement by Minister Gobind Singh Deo
Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation (MDEC) -- DE Rantau Pass FAQ (Foreign), Version 3.0, April 2024

notes: STATUS UPGRADED from draft to published in this pass: both hard requirements now cite tier-1 government sources (digital.gov.my, the Ministry of Digital's own domain, and mdec.my, the statutory body -- Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation -- that administers the pass), replacing the prior tier-3-only sourcing (stampednomad.com, vivre-en-malaisie.com). The USD 24,000 tech-track and USD 60,000 non-tech-track figures are unchanged from the prior draft and are now directly confirmed against these tier-1 documents. STRUCTURAL FINDING, confirmed at tier-1: DE Rantau is legally a Professional Visit Pass (Pas Lawatan Ikhtisas) issued via MDEC endorsement, not a standalone visa category -- consistent with the prior draft's finding. HONEST SOURCING GAP REMAINING: the FAQ document fetched (Version 3.0, April 2024) predates the June 2024 non-tech expansion, so the non-tech figure is sourced to the digital.gov.my press release rather than the FAQ itself; the two sources were not cross-fetched into one document in this pass. The FAQ's own text does not mention a health insurance requirement, despite it appearing (via tier-3 sources) in the prior draft -- kept in evidence_required as a commonly-cited practical requirement, but flagged here as not tier-1-confirmed specifically. Malaysia's favourable foreign-sourced-income tax exemption (LHDN, Income Tax Act 1967) and the prohibition on Malaysian-client income (grounds for pass revocation plus re-entry ban) noted in the prior draft were not re-verified against a fresh tier-1 source in this pass and are not repeated here as confirmed facts.
